sentences.en: Never gave it a thought until Emma mentioned your opponent was all gussied up in flags and balloons.

sentences.en: Whether you have a tomboy or a girly girl, every young woman will have to get gussied up at some point during their childhood.

sentences.en: Victorians loved frilly, fussy, gussied up things - a knick-knack in every available space and swirls and curlicues adorning jewelry and decorative items.

sentences.en: If they are simply directing and marching, having them all gussied up would be fine - but what if their skills go beyond that?
